summary: The study investigates the structural, electrical, and optical properties of Al-doped ZnO (AZO) films deposited via atomic layer deposition (ALD) at 150 °C. The films were prepared by inserting Al2O3 cycles into ZnO cycles to achieve varying Al doping concentrations. The results show that Al doping affects the crystallinity, surface roughness, electrical conductivity, and optical band gap of the films. The optimal Al concentration for low resistivity and high optical transmittance was found to be 3.0 at. %, with a minimum resistivity of 4.4×10−3 cm and optical transmittance over 80% in the visible range.
